Solve a model recursively, milestone by milestone

Source: R/solve_recursive.R
solve_recursive.Rd

Solves the model's horizon window by window instead of all at once. Each window sees only its own milestone years (plus optional look-ahead); capacity built in earlier windows is carried forward as exogenous — sunk, investment-cost-free — stock, aged by each process's lifetime and net of its recorded retirements, and cumulative supply reserves are debited by past use (see solution_ledger() / apply_ledger()).

By default (store = "variants") the whole sequence is ONE scenario: every step is an own-problem variant (runs/s01-2020/…), so the steps share a folder, appear together in scenario_runs(), and are switchable with read_solution(). store = "scenarios" writes one scenario folder per step instead.

Because carried capacity pays no EAC, per-step objective values are not comparable to a perfect-foresight objective; the capacity and activity PATHS are the meaningful comparison, and recursive_objective() recomputes a globally discounted total cost over the decided years.

Usage

solve_recursive(
  object,
  name = NULL,
  ...,
  horizon = NULL,
  step = 1L,
  overlap = 0L,
  carry = c("capacity", "budgets"),
  solver = NULL,
  tolerance = 1e-06,
  store = c("variants", "scenarios"),
  overwrite = FALSE,
  keep_scenarios = TRUE,
  on_error = c("stop", "return"),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

object

a model.

name

character, sequence name (default "<model>_recursive"); names the scenario (or the per-step scenario prefix).

...

forwarded to interpolate_model() for every step (settings / calendar / config overrides).

horizon

the full horizon to split (default: the model's).

step, overlap

window shape, see horizon_windows().

carry

what to carry between steps, see apply_ledger().

solver

solver specification (as in solve_scenario()).

tolerance

carried values below it are treated as zero.

store

"variants" (one scenario, steps as own-problem variants) or "scenarios" (one scenario folder per step).

overwrite

logical; FALSE (default) refuses to run when a variant of the same label already exists on disk with a different type or different parameters. TRUE skips that guard and writes into it.

keep_scenarios

logical, keep each step's solved scenario object in the result (needed by getData() on the result).

on_error

"stop" (default) or "return" (return the partial result with the failed step recorded).

verbose

logical.

Value

an object of class recursive: steps (one row per step: step, run id, decided years, status, objective), scenarios (the solved step objects when kept), ledger (the accumulated solution_ledger()), plus the call parameters. getData() on it stitches per-step results (each year contributed by the step that decided it).

See also

horizon_windows(), solution_ledger(), apply_ledger(), recursive_objective()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
open_project(tempdir())

ek  <- topia$modules$electricity$R3
mod <- newModel("TOPIA", data = ek$repo,
                calendar = topia$modules$calendars$s4_h24,
                region = ek$regions,
                horizon = topia$modules$horizons$base,
                discount = 0.05)
mod <- setGeoscale(mod, ek$geoscale)

# one solve per milestone year, each blind to the next, with capacity
# carried forward
res <- solve_recursive(mod, name = "MYOPIC", step = 1L,
                    solver = solver_options$glpk)
recursive_objective(res, sdr = 0.05)
} # }
